record_policy.creation_rule: This selection step creates no real run records. Exact IDs are selected, but account/live-model qualification, evaluator readiness and paid-execution authorization remain open. Use new-run/prepare-run for each scheduled slot only when proceeding to the qualified execution stage.
record_policy.n_flag_note: new-run --n is a run-ID suffix, not a batch count.
record_policy.retry_rule: Every retry receives a new run ID and separate qualification slot; never replace a started comparison failure with a successful retry.
record_policy.pilot_rule: Pilot runs never enter comparison triples.
record_policy.comparison_rule: Use only the preregistered comparison_run_ids for each cohort; preserve started aborted runs, report pending and pre-start exclusions, and never merge unlike conditions to make a triple.
record_policy.freeze_rule: Changing model, provider, image, adapter, input snapshots or timeout after the freeze starts a new configuration; keep existing records.

stop_rules: Pause expansion when lifecycle/evaluation/integrity prerequisites fail; retain the failure and its evidence.
At each fixed 18-slot cohort endpoint, all three harnesses passing all three repeats on both tasks indicates insufficient task difficulty.
If no harness in a cohort achieves any pass across its completed campaign, investigate model access and contracts before expanding harness components.
Do not stop or select comparison attempts based on interim success; preserve the preregistered denominator.
Apply the recorded operator spend/stop policy; the external 900-second timeout does not enforce a dollar cap.
source_revision_note: Code revision used for offline preparation; freeze the actual revision and sealed inputs again after qualification pilots. Campaign documents were added after this code revision.

pilot_budget.accounting: Use attributable provider usage/billing after each sequential pilot. Harness estimates are provisional; missing or unsettled costs are not zero.
stop_policy: No pilot may start until separate paid-execution authorization and the existing pilot readiness gate are satisfied.
Run one pilot at a time. Reconcile its cost before admitting the next; if attributable cost is unavailable, pause.

Pause the pilot program if any pilot exceeds USD 2 or aggregate pilot spend reaches USD 12. At USD 6 in one cohort, stop further pilots in that cohort; the other cohort may continue within its own allocation and the aggregate budget. Before starting a slot, both applicable budgets must have at least USD 2 remaining.
These are operator admission and stop rules, not an in-flight provider or runner dollar cap. A running request and delayed billing can overshoot.
An aborted or failed pilot consumes its actual cost. No automatic retries or budget transfer between cohorts; extra qualification attempts need a new plan and spending authorization.
Main comparison runs remain unauthorized; do not advance automatically after pilots.
pilot_budget.execution_order: Execute only these six pilot slot_ids in listed order after authorization. Skip all comparison slots; their spending and execution remain separately unauthorized.
pilot_budget.retry_scope: No automatic additional pilot attempts. Existing native HTTP/model retry behavior is unchanged; its calls and charges belong to that attempt.

model_selection_note: 2026-11-07 refresh applies only to future unstarted slots. Old results and eight previous campaign files are preserved. Live access/evaluation/execution authorization remain open.
